notablePrerequisites:
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning a nontoken creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
